topic: Face ID infrared dots on camera
hook: Your phone shoots invisible dots at your face.
title: Your Phone Shoots Invisible Dots at You
description:
Face ID-style phones project a grid of infrared dots to map your face. Your eyes can't see infrared, but many phone cameras can, so a second phone shows the dots as a purple glow. It works best in a dark room and depends on the camera you film with. Part of the Try This Now series.

#Shorts #TryThisNow #PhoneTricks
comment_prompt: Did you see the dots? Yes or no
